records.changes: Fixed whole-family crop below 30% source height removes the blue survey-floor apron; interpolate cut triangles, simplify retained upper community with UV and boundary protection. An authored continuous limestone foundation closes the outer cut perimeter and joins the actual sediment bed; its visible top is included in physical support queries. The foundation is not part of the field scan. Original source images untouched. Dimensions authored, not survey scale.
